== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes will use Zojun's Haste both in and out of combat as a speed boost. While under its effects, they will not attack if they are wielding a melee weapon. They will, however, attack if they are wielding a ranged weapon

== Notes ==
{{speed|5|11|33|30}}
* "Projectiles" means [[ranged attack]]s from weapons, not [[projectile spell]]s.

== Trivia ==
* This skill is named after the [[Canthan Heroes|Canthan hero]] [[Zojun]].
* The figure in the [[skill icon]] is a female [[Ranger]] wearing an [[Ranger Elite Fur-Lined armor|Elite Fur-lined vest]] and [[Ranger Ascalon armor|Ascalon leggings]].
